description:
The niches (trades) this catalogue has read, each with its key, its other names, its TAGS (Google’s own
type words and the kinds of thing on its shelves — e.g. a restaurant niche tagged with the cuisines its
businesses carry) and how many businesses and cards it holds. With `location`: only the niches that have
cards inside the radius, plus `known_not_scanned_here` — niches the catalogue knows but has not read
there (a honest «no» before you search). Use a key, a name or a tag as `niche` in list_cards.
`conditions`: the keys of the deal (a deposit, walk-ins, emergency service, new patients…) with how many
cards confirm each and how many say nothing — the three most published per niche, every one with `niche`.
Every niche
carries `coverage`: `complete` (every city passed cell by cell, no cell at Google’s cap) or `partial` with
`count` (the cards it holds) and `why` — a partial niche may have businesses the catalogue has not read.

location.description: a 5-digit US postcode, a city ("Tampa, FL") or "lat,lng". Optional: without it every niche is listed with its totals.

niche.description: one niche (a key or your words): only it, with EVERY key of the deal it publishes (`conditions`: {key: {confirmed, refuted, unknown}} over the cards inside the radius) — the key to pass as list_cards `properties`

radius_miles.description: How far from the location counts as «here». Default 10.
